keyFindings.description: reapRoleTopics removes a topic only when two consecutive passes see the record at the same revision (kv.go:1117). Every live client re-subscribes on each 90 s heartbeat (envoy-client registerSession; UpsertWithin always Puts with UpdatedAt=now), and the role reaper runs every 5 min (main.go:940), so it never reaps a stale role topic from a live session, which is the only case where the stale topic misleads (GET /v1/sessions, Dispatch's route roster, sender.roles). Reproduced: a throwaway store test with a stale notifications.role.r under a claim naming another session kept the topic through six passes with one heartbeat Upsert between each. role_topics_test.go's 'rewritten' control exhibits the same behaviour and asserts it as a pass. The reaper's conditional Update/Delete is also untested (an unconditional Put leaves all three reaper tests green). AGENTS.md:2047-2051, docs/architecture.md, the CHANGELOG and the SetRoleWithPrevious comment promise the removal.

The detached rollback (kv.go:764-771) reads the claim once and then calls removeInterestTopics, which writes back an unconditional Put. An abandoned claim write that lands after that read, or the client's 250 ms retry that claims while the rollback's Put is in flight, leaves the claim naming the claimant and its record without the role topic; nothing adds it back (the reaper only puts back after its own removal, pi-envoy's heartbeat leaves role topics out, reassertRoleNow writes nothing when the listener already names the holder). Reproduced twice by the deep review. Before this commit an ended request started no rollback, so this could not happen. The doc claim that the rollback 'keeps the topic of a claim that landed after all' (AGENTS.md:2046-2047, kv.go:715-716) is false past the second read. The old holder's detached cleanup uses the same unconditional Put.

When the request ends during the old holder's cleanup, detachedCleanup returns ctx's error while the cleanup keeps running and usually succeeds; SetRoleWithPrevious then logs WARN 'registry role claim old holder cleanup failed ... context canceled' (kv.go:806-812), a failure that did not happen. A real late failure is already logged by detachedCleanup itself.
